messages:
jamal_sales: @maria_product quick intake — DataSight wants us to pin an open model called 'aegir-13b' (13B) in India (apac-in) for a paid pilot. They specifically asked for an 8-bit quantized variant and dedicated capacity for 10k reqs/day. timeline: 2 weeks for POC.

maria_product: thanks Jamal. need a few checks first — region availability, quantized weights support, and compliance for India. can you confirm customer SLA expectations and whether they need private deployment?

jamal_sales: they want an SLA similar to dedicated (99.9) and data isolation but are open to dedicated in our hosted APAC-IN region first. legal said nothing blocking but want KMS + audit logs.

alex_infra: tagging infra team — quick feasibility questions: do we have a prebuilt q8 variant of aegir-13b on our catalog? if not, conversion + test could add ~5 business days. also need to check GPU memory for q8 runtime.

sophie_pm: put minimal launch criteria: (1) model passes perf smoke (latency < 350ms p95 for chat use), (2) quantized output quality within 5% of baseline eval, (3) deployable to apac-in with logging + KMS. if any blockers, call out immediate tradeoffs.

kevin_support: from support/ops — we'll need runbook + fallback model for outages. recommend fallback -> aegir-6b or regional reroute to apac-sin. also request token-level cost estimate for customer pricing.

jamal_sales: noted. customer also asked about version pinning (they want v1.2 pinned for the pilot). can we do model-version pinning in private/dedicated?

alex_infra: yes, pinning supported for dedicated pools. for hosted, we can pin to a specific artifact hash + rollout policy. need the model artifact uploaded to catalog and a signed manifest.

maria_product: action items: Jamal — confirm whether DataSight will upload weights or expect us to pull from upstream. Alex — run quick feasibility (q8 artifact exists? mem estimate + perf). Sophie — add launch checklist & eval prompt set. Kevin — cost + runbook draft. I'll prioritize this intake in next planning sync.

jamal_sales: DataSight will provide the open weights URL (OSS license) and wants us to host. I'll get them to sign SOW for dedicated POC.

infra-bot: intake created #INT-4521: aegir-13b apac-in pin request. Assigned: alex_infra. ETA for feasibility: 3 business days.

alex_infra: started local build of q8 variant. first perf pass queued. will post artifacts and mem numbers in this thread.

maria_product: perfect. adding to product backlog under "Model Catalog - Geo pin requests" with priority: high (customer POC + revenue). will update roadmap doc after feasibility. :thumbsup:

kevin_support: added provisional runbook template to /docs/onboarding/runbooks/INT-4521. share notes if anyone updates.

jamal_sales: thanks team — I'll sync with DataSight and update once SOW is signed.

infra-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up in 72h for INT-4521.
